summary: This app allows users to create, design, and customize their own spacecraft. Users can choose different spacecraft parts, such as engines, wings, fuel tanks, and other components. They can build their own spacecraft, explore different designs, and learn about space engineering. The app encourages creativity, problem-solving, and learning about space exploration.
